page.notes: Doubtful readings: "plenâ" (first word, the line begins "pleta" with a tilde-like mark, possibly "plenâ"); "Itaqua" (could be "Itaque"); "hprafi" (unclear, possibly a corrupted or Hebrew-related word, copied as seen); "Remmst." (may be "Remonst."). Hyphenated line breaks kept: "adeo-que", "acce-tantis", "impu-tari", "fide-ijussorem", "cre-". The Greek "λαμ-βάνομεν" is hyphenated across the line. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. The marginal note "Episcop. disp. 22. de justif. thes. 5." is placed where its mark stands in the text, and its exact punctuation in the scan is slightly uncertain. The word "justif." in that note is read from "ju-stif". The printed margin note is shown as "thef." in the scan and is rendered here as "thes.", which is a likely reading.
